f3f7534be703fa16af43d34022a27176d80fd794: Corno alle Scale is a small, understated resort — 14 km of runs for an intimate skiing experience, far from the bustle of the big resorts. This is where people come for calm, authenticity and no queues at the lifts. Corno alle Scale's family reputation is well deserved: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Apennines for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Corno alle Scale's modest altitude — base at 1418 m, summit at 1945 m — makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before you leave is strongly advised. At €38, the day lift pass places Corno alle Scale in the mid-range category on budget — neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short, Corno alle Scale doesn't compete with the giants of skiing, and doesn't pretend to. It's an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
